## Checklist

- [ ] The PR contains one coherent behavioral concern.
- [ ] Tests cover the regression or acceptance criteria.
- [ ] User-facing text includes English and Simplified Chinese.
- [ ] No secret, private hostname, private message, or local runtime configuration is included.
- [ ] Documentation and deployment examples are updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] Commits use Conventional Commit subjects and DCO sign-off.
